column1: # The survey reports the same memory layout as 0100E95004038000; the NPDM declares no system resource.
# Native rates for Japan 3.0.1. The game's event flag returns scripted scenes to 30 FPS.
# Game and UI steps follow measured frame time up to 1/15 s. The game's event byte controls the 30 FPS cap.
# The data page holds simulation step, limiter wait, 30 FPS scale, swap interval and cloth scale.
# Use the game's 30 FPS initial values until the first frame.
# Install the plan only when the main Build ID and the original instructions match.
# Patch sites and particle, renderer, camera and cloth corrections were cross-checked with xc2-recomp. See LICENSE.xc2-recomp.
# The helpers cover synchronization, particles, rendering, camera, cloth, damping and engine pacing.
# Divide the simulation step by the swap interval to retain the game's step calculation.
# Scale particles, render animation and camera timing from the 30 FPS baseline.
# Scale cloth and hair displacement and rotation by the step, preserving the quaternion direction.
# Interpolate damping from the exact retention values at 30, 60 and 120 FPS.
# At interval one the host limiter paces frames. The engine wait remains at 30 and 20 FPS and during events.
